notes.title: Hotfix - Cleopatra side mission
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

We have released a new build with fixes for the Cleopatra side mission.
There was an issue with the Mill-Farm or Clover paddock version of this mission not terminating properly.

If you've encountered this issue in your game, simply reattempt the race with Cleopatra. It should now complete properly.

notes.title: Hotfix: Cleopatra & Decorations Minigame
notes.content:

[*]"A Ride Out for Cleopatra" won't finish

[/list]

notes.title: Functional Update
notes.content:
Hello Horse Adventurers!

With this update, we fixed a bug that prevented Steam achievements from being unlocked.

All achievements should now work again.

To trigger achievements that you already unlocked, but that were not displayed in Steam, you can complete any race in the game - since that is where the savegame gets updated - and it [i]should[/i] work.

If problems persist, hop over to the discussions in the Community Hub, and we will have a look.

Best,

your KORION-Team!

tags.bug: - With this update, we fixed a bug that prevented Steam achievements from being unlocked.
